item.text: {"counterevidence":["The same segment 548 snapshot shows 1,626,084 Dth/day of available capacity and zero net scheduled quantity in TD1, while TD2 shows zero available capacity. This directional asymmetry argues against treating the segment as wholly unavailable. Evidence: km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc.","The latest report revisions include increases of 290,000 Dth/day for segment 245 and 209,000 Dth/day for segment 163 during specified future weeks. These changes do not offset restrictions elsewhere automatically, but they show the revision is not uniformly reducing capacity. Evidence: km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063.","Several watched rows still show available capacity, including 134,876 Dth/day on segment 187 TD2, 115,648 Dth/day on segment 530 TD2, and 553,018 Dth/day at MLV 324 TD1. The packet therefore does not establish complete transport unavailability. Evidence: km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc.","The reported reductions are forecasts for future maintenance periods. The packet contains no measured physical-flow decline, production loss, price response, or confirmation that every planned activity will occur as scheduled. Evidence: km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063."],"facts":[{"claim":"Notice 403802 was updated on August 27, 2026 and forecasts maintenance-related capacity conditions from August 31 through November 29 across 30 stations and 467 station-period rows. Its largest reported reduction is 868,000 Dth/day.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"The capacity snapshot is stale: it was posted August 28 at 17:47 UTC, 45.19 hours before the decision time and beyond the 30-hour freshness limit. It represents gas day August 28, not current August 30 conditions.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_point_delivery_capacity:1787941559190690000:af85aeca5742b4ed993c3014ada6f612283a8a047e4e7c76671b8029bcfd3f05","km_tgp_point_receipt_capacity:1787941570545179000:37ca0a5593065278dad5d89f8a85f0f1116def0c3ba01b8dfeef1c38f40cfb96","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc"]},{"claim":"In the stale segment 548 snapshot, the Station 860 South 500 Line TD2 row shows operating capacity of 1,390,000 Dth/day, net scheduled quantity of 1,449,906 Dth/day, and zero operationally available capacity. The associated outage forecast reaches a maximum planned reduction of 868,000 Dth/day between August 31 and October 25.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"In the stale segment 187 snapshot, the Station 110 South TD2 row shows 134,876 Dth/day of operationally available capacity and 1,940,124 Dth/day of net scheduled quantity. The associated maintenance forecast has a maximum planned reduction of 863,000 Dth/day through November 29.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"In the stale segment 530 snapshot, the Station 534 South of Pool TD2 row shows operating capacity of 985,000 Dth/day, net scheduled quantity of 869,352 Dth/day, and 115,648 Dth/day of operationally available capacity. Forecast revisions reduce operating capacity by 565,000 Dth/day during September 7–20 and by 645,000 Dth/day during October 5–11.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"Across the supplied capacity snapshot, 100 rows have operating capacity below design capacity, 39 have zero operationally available capacity, and seven have scheduled quantity at or above operating capacity. These are capacity and scheduling observations, not measurements of physical flow.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_point_delivery_capacity:1787941559190690000:af85aeca5742b4ed993c3014ada6f612283a8a047e4e7c76671b8029bcfd3f05","km_tgp_point_receipt_capacity:1787941570545179000:37ca0a5593065278dad5d89f8a85f0f1116def0c3ba01b8dfeef1c38f40cfb96","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc"]},{"claim":"TD1 and TD2 are the capacity table's map-based direction indicators. BH and FH are outage-report labels. The packet does not establish that either label system maps directly to the other.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]}],"glossary":[{"definition":"Dekatherms per day, a daily measure of natural-gas energy quantity.","term":"Dth/day"},{"definition":"Posted transport capacity that remains available under the operator's current scheduling and operating assumptions. It is not measured physical flow.","term":"Operationally available capacity"},{"definition":"The operator's current capacity estimate after accounting for operating conditions such as maintenance, pressure, or gas quality.","term":"Operating capacity"},{"definition":"An engineering estimate of a segment's capacity under stated assumptions; it can differ from operating capacity.","term":"Design capacity"},{"definition":"The net quantity scheduled after volumes in opposite directions are combined. It is not necessarily the quantity physically flowing.","term":"Net scheduled quantity"},{"definition":"The difference between gas prices at two locations or between a local location and a benchmark.","term":"Basis"},{"definition":"The capacity table's native directions: TD1 follows the direction shown on the operator's segment map, while TD2 is the opposite direction.","term":"TD1 and TD2"}],"headline":"Stale capacity data sharply limits confidence; future TGP maintenance merits monitoring but does not establish a trade","missing_data":["A fresh TGP capacity snapshot for the latest scheduling cycles, including operating capacity, operationally available capacity, and net scheduled quantities.","Current and historical prices for relevant locations on both sides of each watched segment, plus Henry Hub or another appropriate benchmark.","Actual metered physical flows and confirmed nominations; operationally available capacity and scheduled quantities are not substitutes for flow.","Current production, demand, storage injections or withdrawals, weather forecasts, and LNG or other major demand observations relevant to the affected system.","Futures prices, calendar spreads, volatility, liquidity, and contract timing needed to evaluate a trade setup.","A verified geographic and commercial mapping of each segment to upstream and downstream pricing locations.","Subsequent notice revisions confirming whether the maintenance dates and capacity reductions remain current.","Resolution of the packet's quality warnings, including unreconciled notice-index counts, flagged operator reductions, regressed source clocks, and unprocessed archived artifacts."],"overall_confidence":"low","plain_english_summary":"The capacity snapshot is stale: it is 45.19 hours old and represents August 28 conditions, so it cannot establish current transport tightness. TGP notice 403802 identifies substantial future maintenance reductions, led by as much as 868,000 Dth/day, and several stale snapshot rows had limited or zero additional capacity in one native direction. These observations justify monitoring segments 548, 187, 530, 324, and 399. They do not show physical-flow losses, a price effect, or a trade setup. Fresh pipeline data and market, weather, storage, production, and futures observations are required.","watch_items":[{"confidence":"low","confirmation_needed":["A fresh segment 548 capacity posting showing whether TD2 operationally available capacity remains near zero.","Updated notice revisions confirming the size and timing of maintenance from August 31 through October 25.","Current nominations, confirmed schedules, and metered physical flows in each direction.","Prices and basis on verified upstream and downstream locations, plus demand, production, storage, weather, and futures context."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"],"invalidation":["Fresh postings show substantial available capacity in the relevant direction.","The planned maintenance is delayed, canceled, shortened, or assigned a smaller reduction.","Schedules move to other paths or fall enough that the segment retains adequate flexibility.","Verified prices on either side show no meaningful separation during the restriction."],"market_channel":"Transport and upstream/downstream basis","scenario":"If a fresh posting confirms that segment 548 still has little or no additional transport capacity in the relevant native direction as the planned reduction begins, shippers could have less routing flexibility. That could conditionally separate prices across the constrained path or require schedule changes. The packet does not identify the relevant pricing locations or demonstrate any price response, and TD2 must not be treated as equivalent to the outage report's BH label.","title":"Segment 548 transport-flexibility watch"},{"confidence":"low","confirmation_needed":["Current segment 187 capacity and scheduling data for both TD1 and TD2.","Confirmation of the force-majeure, repair, replacement, and inspection schedules in the latest operator notice.","Verified upstream and downstream pricing-location mapping and current basis observations.","Metered flows, nominations, production, demand, storage, weather, and futures data."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"],"invalidation":["Fresh data show materially more available capacity or lower scheduling pressure.","Maintenance reductions are postponed, reduced, or canceled.","Alternate transportation paths absorb scheduled demand without constraint.","Verified local prices and basis remain insensitive during the maintenance period."],"market_channel":"Transport and upstream/downstream basis","scenario":"If segment 187's available capacity remains limited while the forecast reduction reaches 863,000 Dth/day, transportation across that segment could become less flexible. Under that condition, upstream and downstream prices could diverge, but the direction and size cannot be inferred without geography, prices, actual flows, and supply-demand data.","title":"Segment 187 extended-maintenance watch"},{"confidence":"low","confirmation_needed":["Fresh capacity cycles for segments 530, 324, and 399 during their September maintenance windows.","Updated notices confirming the revised reductions and exact work dates.","Confirmed schedules and metered flows before, during, and after each maintenance period.","Mapped regional prices, basis, storage activity, production, demand, weather, and futures-market observations."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1787941582228921000:9656fa2a506c07d456fb97da8f0437185501849c2416052b63936f2819e69acc","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"],"invalidation":["The affected work is canceled, rescheduled, or completed without the forecast reduction.","Fresh postings show sufficient available capacity throughout the relevant direction and dates.","Shippers use alternate paths and no local scheduling constraint develops.","Price and basis data show no separation associated with the maintenance windows."],"market_channel":"Transport and regional basis","scenario":"Overlapping September work on segments 530, 324, and 399 could conditionally create localized transport constraints if current scheduling demand persists and the planned reductions occur. Any upstream- or downstream-basis effect requires confirmation from fresh capacity, actual flows, mapped pricing locations, and broader supply-demand data; it is not established by this packet.","title":"September overlapping-maintenance watch"}],"why_it_matters":"The notice identifies several future periods when TGP expects less operating capacity, and some watched paths already had limited additional capacity in the stale August 28 snapshot. If fresh data confirm those conditions, transport flexibility could fall and regional basis relationships could change. Because the snapshot is stale and no prices, physical flows, storage, weather, production, or futures data are loaded, the evidence supports monitoring only—not a causal price claim or trade recommendation."}
